summary: Patient missed appointment due to lack of reminder and forgetting the scheduled visit. Requested to reschedule for next week.
recommended_action: Reschedule appointment and verify patient contact information for future automated reminders.

summary: Patient missed appointment due to high consultation fees and inquired about potential discounts for follow-up visits.
recommended_action: Provide patient with information regarding financial assistance programs or sliding scale fee options.

summary: Patient missed appointment due to high fever and body aches. Plans to reschedule once recovered.
recommended_action: Flag for rescheduling once the patient contacts the clinic after recovery.

summary: Patient missed appointment due to an urgent, mandatory work meeting. Requested an evening appointment for future visits.
recommended_action: Reschedule patient for an evening time slot and update preference in the system.

summary: Patient forgot the appointment and stated they did not receive an SMS reminder. They requested to reschedule.
recommended_action: Reschedule appointment and verify patient contact information for SMS notifications.

summary: Patient missed appointment due to a city bus strike and lack of local transportation options, compounded by the distance to the clinic.
recommended_action: Offer telehealth options or assist with patient transport services for future appointments.

summary: Patient unreachable after three attempts; phone was switched off.
recommended_action: Send automated follow-up via SMS or email to request appointment rescheduling.

summary: Patient missed appointment due to a factory shift change and requested Saturday availability.
recommended_action: Update patient preference to Saturday only and offer waitlist for weekend slots.
